artifact_policy: No fitted model or calibrator is serialized and deployment is unchanged.

calibration.selection: retain methods within raw +0.002 Brier and +0.01 log loss; choose lowest pooled ECE, with differences <=0.005 favoring simplicity

endpoint_gates.origin_reliability: at least 3/4 origins with ECE <= 0.12 and calibration gap <= 0.08

explanation_policy: If the two recent-involvement inputs have absolute Spearman correlation above 0.9, expose only their combined group contribution; do not present independent causal or importance claims.
final_holdout_policy: No extension signed in 2024 or later is evaluated.

profile_support.limited: outside a training 1st-99th percentile or above the learned P95 robust-distance envelope
profile_support.refused: missing required input, unseen category, outside observed range, or above the learned P99 robust-distance envelope

scope: probability reliability audit only; no feature or model-family search

subgroup_support.brier_skill_rule: 99% player-cluster interval lower bound above zero
